item.title: 0.8.6-preprod.3
item.description:
muesli 0.8.6-preprod.3

  • Meet Vidshots: record a window or screen region with spoken narration, then revisit the recording and transcript. Find it in the updated What's New tour.
  • Permission setup now guides you through enabling access and restarting muesli, returning to Time Turner setup afterward. Restart checks protect active work and unsent chat drafts.
  • Dictate while a meeting is recording, with improvements to meeting titles and summaries.
  • Browse meeting people and improve calendar-linked meeting recording and call detection.
  • Summary failure logs omit provider error details while keeping useful errors in the app.

This preproduction build is for testing the update from 0.8.6-preprod.2. Check update discovery, installation, relaunch, preserved data and the Vidshots tour card before production release.

item.title: 0.8.6-preprod.2
item.description:
muesli 0.8.6 preproduction 2

This second preview includes the latest 0.8.6 interface and permission-recovery improvements for upgrade and everyday-use testing before the stable release.

New in this preview

  • Defer permission setup and continue to Timeline. Features explain missing access and take you to Settings → General → Permissions when needed. Voice Notes onboarding can test recording without granting text-pasting access.
  • System Audio permission checks support retry and preserve a Grant click made while a background check is running.
  • Discover major additions through small New badges that disappear after interaction.
  • Read clearer accent-colored actions, open Insights from the Timeline or Dictations statistics tiles, and use the simpler Timeline filter.
  • Dismiss individual App Formatting suggestions. Time Turner settings stay compact until capture is enabled.

Bring your conversations and documents

  • Import meeting notes, summaries and transcripts from a Granola ZIP or CSV export. Preview the meetings before importing from Meetings → Import → Granola…
  • Chat with saved meetings, follow citations to their source, and attach PDFs, images, Markdown or plain-text documents. Documents stay in their original location; muesli does not keep managed copies. The model can search and read documents as needed.
  • New general chats start with no meetings selected. Choose individual meetings or a folder; opening chat within a meeting supplies that meeting's context.
  • Use on-device Gemma 4 or your preferred AI provider. Supported local endpoints can use native tool calling with capability detection.

More ways to write

  • Cotypist is now included in preprod and production packages. It stays off until enabled in Settings → Experimental. Complete its input-source setup for on-device suggestions, then press Tab to accept a suggestion or Option + Right Arrow to accept one word. Accepted suggestions appear in your local Timeline with the preceding text and app name.
  • With a supported local model, enable “Watch text appear during hands-free mode” in Settings → Dictations. Enabled cleanup runs when you stop.
  • Ask Quill a question, follow up, or request an edit to selected text. Configure it in Settings → Experimental.
  • Set writing styles, capitalization and final-period preferences per app in Settings → Dictations → App Formatting.

Find and revisit your work

  • Search saved dictations, meetings, chats, writing history and Time Turner screen text from the sidebar or with Command + F.
  • Time Turner lets you browse captured screen text and screenshots. Capture is off by default and screen history stays on this Mac. Generating a recap sends sampled text to your selected Meetings provider.
  • Record a window or display alongside meeting audio when you choose Record Screen… in the meeting controls. Video stays local and requires Screen Recording permission.

Models and refinements

  • Try Parakeet Redux, Phonon-2.5 and MedASR from Models → Dictation. MedASR requires acceptance of Google's model terms.
  • Updated muesli Cleanup Lite and Pro Cleanup — Qwen 3.5 models have an Update action when newer model files are available.
  • Saved API keys and supported account credentials migrate to macOS Keychain, with verification before legacy credentials are removed.
  • Includes recording-indicator dragging, live-caption, meeting-control and reminder fixes, plus an updated guided What's New tour.

Hosted features send the input and context needed for the request to the selected provider. File references require the originals to remain available.

Test the update

Keep the older MuesliPreprod installed and choose Check for Updates after the preproduction feed is live. Check installation, relaunch, saved data and credentials, and the What's New tour. MuesliPreprod uses separate local app data; the stable release remains 0.8.5.

item.title: 0.8.5-preprod.2
item.description:
Muesli 0.8.5 preproduction 2

This preview includes the 0.8.5 features plus two fixes from preproduction testing:

  • Change a disabled shortcut directly to resolve a conflict, without changing Dictation first or enabling the feature automatically.
  • Improves Check for Updates window presentation while Muesli is open. Existing updater windows can be brought forward; recovery stops after presentation so later minimize or focus choices are respected.

Update from 0.8.5-preprod.1 to test installation. After relaunch, check for updates with the dashboard active, with another app active, and with existing updater UI to verify the presentation fix.

Meet Muesli at the notch

Choose Notch in Settings → Appearance to follow recording, processing, and Computer Use progress at the top of your screen. Displays without a notch use the Classic indicator.

Change settings with your voice

Enable Computer Use Command in Shortcuts, then ask Muesli to change a setting or shortcut. Use experimental local Gemma or your connected ChatGPT account. Muesli asks for clarification when needed and checks that changes were saved. AI instructions and prompt settings remain manual-only.

Claude for meeting notes

Choose Anthropic with your API key, or a signed-in Claude Code installation, as your meeting summary backend. Meeting content is sent to Claude when you choose it.

Re-transcribe saved meetings

Give an existing meeting another pass using a downloaded meeting model and its retained audio. Follow progress while browsing elsewhere in Muesli, or cancel and keep the original result. Re-transcription needs saved audio and replaces the transcript when completed.

No need to hold all the time

Choose Press to toggle in Shortcuts → Dictation and assign a modifier + key shortcut. Press once to start dictation, then again to stop.

Bodhan, in your preferred script

Choose Native, Mixed, or Romanized output for Bodhan Flex. Write Indic speech in Latin letters using the same downloaded model. Mixed remains the default.

More control over meetings

  • Show scheduled meetings for the next six or twelve hours, alongside the existing day-based windows.
  • Hide an individual event directly from the status-bar menu without deleting it from your calendar.
  • Improves meeting detection, stop controls, clipboard pasting, and navigation through long meeting-folder lists.
  • Adds a guided What’s New tour using the real app controls.

Dictation and meeting transcription remain local by default. Hosted features send the input needed for the selected feature to its provider.

Testing this preview

MuesliPreprod installs alongside Muesli with separate local app data. To test the updater, keep your older MuesliPreprod installed and use Check for Updates after the preproduction feed is live. The stable release and Homebrew version remain 0.8.4.

item.title: 0.8.4-preprod.1
item.description:
MuesliPreprod 0.8.4-preprod.1

Pre-production build for validating the Sparkle update flow before a stable release.

Install

  • Download MuesliPreprod-0.8.4-preprod.1.dmg
  • Open the DMG and drag MuesliPreprod to Applications
  • Launch MuesliPreprod from Applications

Notes

  • Installs alongside production Muesli.
  • Stores data separately in ~/Library/Application Support/MuesliPreprod/.
  • Uses the pre-production Sparkle feed: https://muesli-hq.github.io/muesli/appcast-preprod.xml.
  • Does not update the production appcast, public download page, or Homebrew tap.
